summary: Customer is developing a hot polymer extrusion process with an active pharmaceutical ingredient and wants to know whether an optical measurement can detect composition changes in the melt during processing. They have offline assays, note the process interface is hot and may be exposed to material build-up, and request an initial comparison plan and the questions required before choosing a probe.
